project_meta.title: What If Electricity Was Never Invented?

global_style.art_style: Minimalist hand-drawn stickman storytelling animation, vertical 9:16 composition. Warm off-white paper background, bold slightly imperfect black ink outlines, simple expressive stickman characters with round white faces, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, no irises, no highlights, no eye whites, no eyelashes, and no realistic eye details. Identical eye size, shape, and spacing in every image. Thin black stick limbs, simple curved mouths, limited earthy accent colors such as muted brown, orange, dark blue, and pale yellow. Hand-drawn environments with simple but recognizable objects, expressive body language, cinematic visual storytelling, varied camera angles, clear foreground and background separation, visually engaging compositions. Every beat is a distinct illustration matching the exact moment of narration. Keep recurring characters visually consistent.
global_style.negative_prompt: Photorealism, 3D rendering, anime, detailed realistic human anatomy, complex facial features, pupils, irises, eye highlights, reflections in eyes, eye whites, eyelashes, changing eye shapes, inconsistent character designs, cluttered backgrounds, excessive text, captions, subtitles, logos, watermarks, blurry artwork, overly detailed textures, modern electric appliances, glowing screens, electric streetlights, or electrical infrastructure in a world where electricity never existed.
